persona: Mid-level plant HR executive with a few gaps
resumeText:
Sneha Kulkarni | Pune | sneha.kulkarni@example.com

EXPERIENCE
HR Executive, Sahyadri Autocomp Pvt Ltd, Chakan, Pune (2022 - present)
- Handle joining formalities, induction and exit formalities for 450 plant and office staff.
- Compile monthly attendance, leave and overtime as payroll inputs for the finance team.
- File monthly PF and ESIC challans and keep registers under the Shops and Establishments Act.
- Maintain employee records and leave balances in greytHR.
- Prepare monthly headcount and attrition MIS reports in Excel with pivot tables.
- Coordinated the annual appraisal cycle for 120 staff and tracked KRA forms.
- Screened resumes and scheduled interviews for 30 shop-floor hires a year.

HR Assistant, Indrayani Packwell Pvt Ltd, Pune (2020 - 2022)
- Collected joining documents and opened personnel files for new workers.
- Organised festival celebrations and quarterly employee engagement activities.

EDUCATION
MBA (HR), Savitribai Phule Pune University, 2020

SKILLS
greytHR, MS Excel, HR policies, PF and ESI
